description: This PHP source file defines the 'AOR_ChartsController' class, which extends 'SugarController' and includes a method 'action_getImageMap' responsible for generating and outputting an image map for chart visualization within the SuiteCRM application.

classes.name: AOR_ChartsController
classes.description: Controller class for handling chart-related actions in SuiteCRM, specifically for generating image maps for charts.

methods.name: action_getImageMap
methods.description: Generates and outputs an image map for a chart if 'imageMapId' is provided in the request. It utilizes the pChart library to create the image map and saves it in a cache directory.
